about: Database management in a single PHP file.

prs.title: PostgreSQL exports with identity columns import again
prs.broken: Tables keyed by an always-generated identity column exported inserts that PostgreSQL rejects, so those tables came back empty on import.
prs.changed: The export now adds the clause PostgreSQL needs to accept the saved ids.
prs.matters: Exported databases can be restored with their rows and links intact.
